reasons: Legitimate refunds never require you to enter your UPI PIN or approve a 'collect request'.
Entering a PIN is only for sending money, never for receiving it.
The message uses artificial urgency to pressure the victim.
red_flags_found: Request to enter UPI PIN to receive money
Use of 'collect request' for a refund
Urgency / threat words (pressure to act fast)
UPI collect request / 'enter PIN to receive money' trick
Refund/cashback bait with a contact or link
advice: Do not approve any UPI collect requests or enter your PIN.
Report the incident on cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930.
